reasoning_per_edit.rationale: The validateSession function reuses the cached token before checking expiry. Move the expiry check before the cache lookup so an expired token triggers a refresh.
reasoning_per_edit.disproving_evidence: If the test still fails after this change, the cache key must be wrong elsewhere; check src/auth/cache.ts.

risks: Other callers of validateSession may not expect the function to perform a refresh; check src/auth/index.ts and src/api/routes/login.ts.
